name: listening-android
description: 听音乐 Android 壳（Capacitor）。页面本身在 ../examples，打包前由 scripts/build-www.mjs 拷进 www/

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
